featured_reviews.review_text:
"A Haven for Book Lovers: Crossword Bookstore, Inorbit Mall, Malad"

I recently visited the Crossword Bookstore at Inorbit Mall in Malad, and I must say, it was an absolute delight! As a book enthusiast, I was thrilled to discover this treasure trove of literature.

The store is spacious and well-organized, with a vast collection of books across various genres. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, always willing to offer recommendations or assistance.

What impressed me most was the store's ambiance – cozy, quiet, and perfect for getting lost in a good book. The seating area is comfortable, and the café serves a variety of snacks and beverages.

Whether you're a casual reader or a bookworm, Crossword Bookstore at Inorbit Mall, Malad, is a must-visit destination. I'll definitely be back for more!

*Rating Breakdown:*

- Ambiance: 5/5
- Book Collection: 5/5
- Staff: 5/5
- Overall Experience: 5/5

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience.

Due to a misunderstanding, we were given 2 Master Key books and 3 textbooks instead of the books we actually needed. Today (26/06/2026) When my husband went back to exchange or return them, the shopkeeper refused to accept the return or provide a refund. Instead, he insisted that we buy other books from the store.

We understand that every shop has its own return policy, but the way he spoke to us was extremely rude and disrespectful. He kept saying, "Hurry up, I don't have time," without even listening properly.

Good customer service is not just about selling products—it is also about treating customers with respect. The attitude and behavior were very disappointing. I hope they improve both their customer service and the way they communicate with customers. 👎👎

featured_reviews.review_text: I have had a wonderful experience with book bond by Neha. The curation of book set is very age appropriate and my child relates and learns a lot  from it. I recently visited the Book Bond store and it was such a wonderful experience. The staff has been so helpful with the selection of books for my baby and also I could attend a book launch and signing which was so well organised.
I recommend Book Bond to everyone who needs to find the best (age appropriate) books for their little ones and have great guidance from their team while doing so. Cannot wait to buy my next set of books from them :)

featured_reviews.name: Anshika Maheshwari
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve bought over 100 books from Book Bond over the years, and earlier this year subscribed to their monthly subscription box. It’s been an outstanding experience so far. The books are curated for my children’s age and it’s evident that a lot of thought has been put into choosing every book. My girls eagerly wait for their subscription box every month :)

featured_reviews.name: Pankhuri Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took subscription from Book bond online and really liked the concept of subscription.
Book bond has really good collections of books and my child has enjoyed a lot :)

featured_reviews.name: Sabina Yasmin
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've always been an avid reader of all sorts of books, and now, every single day, my heart fills with joy seeing my little one show the same interest and enthusiasm with her amazing and interactive books collection from Book Bond.
As much as she enjoys running around the house on her tiny feet, doing all sorts of innocent mischief, and helping with chores, I've quietly noticed her love for books. All thanks to Book Bond!
While she adores herself in the mirror and throws the occasional tantrum, sometimes leaving cute trails of destruction, watching her turn the pages and then coming to me or her papa to ask us to read to her fills my heart with joy. I'm happy that these tiny resemblances are shaping her beautifully, and there's no way we would have parented her otherwise.
It couldn't have been possible if I hadn't stumbled upon this amazing book store. After all, what better way to reduce kid's screen time than to foster their love for reading, right?
